Great gesture from Commonwelath and adidas 👏🏼

Commonwealth is a retailer based in the Philippines and is an adidas Constorium partner

They were due to release this limited edition Forum Laceless, and instead of using the funds for the
marketing, they have donated it to various charities that are helping residents of locations that have been hit hard by recent flooding

The shoes are limited to just 450 pairs, with each pair
individually numbered, and all proceeds from the sales is being donated by brand and retailer to the charities as well

Any pairs not sold are also being donated

A massive blaze tore through the Wang Fuk Court housing estate in Tai Po, Hong Kong, on November 26, 2025, claiming 128 lives so far—the city's worst since 1948.

The fire, sparked by renovation materials like foam boards and bamboo scaffolding, spread rapidly across seven of the eight high-rise blocks, trapping thousands of residents.

Fire alarms in all buildings failed to sound, delaying escape—residents ran door-to-door to warn neighbors amid thick smoke and chaos.

Rescue ops wrapped Friday with 79 injured (including 12 firefighters); only 39 victims ID'd, many migrant workers from Philippines and Indonesia.

Gov vows probes, arrests for negligence, and safety upgrades—heartbreak as families wait.

Tragic failure—how can cities prevent this nightmare? Share your thoughts below!
